instruction: Repo owner, live in this conversation, said: "merge into master and push, no changelog or version bump required," referring to docs/friendly-readme, a docs-only rewrite of README.md (adds a friendly non-developer intro + HA Add-on setup walkthrough above the existing developer/architecture content, which is preserved under a "For developers and self-hosters" heading). notes: Preflight: docs-only change, no backend/frontend code touched, so no tsc/vitest/build gate applies (confirmed via git diff scope: README.md only).
